items.title: Kunal Kamra moves Supreme Court in 7-judge bench case on limits of legislative privileges
items.summary: Comedian Kunal Kamra has approached the Supreme Court seeking to intervene in a case pending before a seven-judge Bench of the Court on the extent to which an exercise of legislative privileges can be used to curtail a citizen’s freedom of speech.
